title: Two cosines lock the third: the Gram window
title_zh: 两条余弦锁住第三条：格拉姆窗口
summary: Fix two cosines among three unit vectors and the third is locked into a window: C circles B, A·C swings between cos(θ₁ + θ₂) and cos(θ₁ − θ₂), det G is the squared volume and vanishes on the edges, the windows fill an ellipse, and at the top edge an overlap of one forces C = A, as a Lean theorem of chapter 29 states.
summary_zh: 三根单位向量中定下两条余弦，第三条就被锁进窗口：C 绕 B 转一圈，A·C 在 cos(θ₁ + θ₂) 与 cos(θ₁ − θ₂) 之间摆动；det G 是体积的平方，在窗边为零；各个窗口铺满一个椭圆；上沿处内积为 1 迫使 C = A，正如第二十九章的一条 Lean 定理所述。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · three unit vectors on a sphere, the Gram window and its ellipse
